notes: Fixed simulator tray closing so a newly inserted disc cannot inherit the previous completed or failed job.
Simulator tray closing now inserts a disc 80% of the time, and every inserted disc starts as Disk detected.
Simulator rips now succeed 90% of the time and fail 10% of the time with a simulated read error.
Sped up fake ripping by approximately five-and-a-half times for quicker demonstrations.
These simulator-only changes do not affect live Rip Nodes or real ripping speeds.
Bundled Rip Node API remains v0.2.5.
